scope: Previously screened verses reconciled; nonpublic; not comprehensive
methodology: Faithful reconciliation of PR #203 preliminary screening, checked against PR #204 for adjacent range. No new primary-language or manuscript verification. No literary-dependence assertion. No Supabase/public changes.

verses.summary: Covenant fulfillment, lawful livestock, and hunting restriction during consecration; compare covenant/vow law separately from Israelite food and sacred-time rules.
pending_questions: Check Hebrew vows and livestock terminology; no presumed equivalent of Islamic ihram.

verses.summary: Sacred months, offerings, marked sacrificial animals, pilgrimage access, and prohibition of retaliatory aggression; legal complexes are not interchangeable.
pending_questions: Compare festival pilgrimage and sacrificial animals; do not posit pre-Islamic text for Meccan sanctuary without evidence.

verses.summary: Carrion, blood, pork, slaughter and divination restrictions; multiple distinct legal motifs and pre-Islamic Arabian practices.
pending_questions: Compare dietary details and scope, distinguish Hebrew sacrificial law from Arabian divining arrows; verify each primary passage.

verses.summary: Lawful foods and game caught by trained hunting animals; identify whether a genuinely earlier legal treatment exists.
pending_questions: Do not treat generic permitted animals as proof of a parallel for trained hunting dogs.

verses.summary: Food exchange and marriage with People of the Book; earlier intermarriage rules may contrast rather than correspond.
pending_questions: Compare actual scope and chronology of Jewish/Christian marriage rules; avoid equating all communities.

verses.summary: Washing before prayer, major purification, and dry ablution in absence of water; potential comparison with priestly and ritual immersion laws.
pending_questions: Distinguish priestly hand/foot washing and impurity immersion from Muslim wudu/ghusl/tayammum; seek pre-Islamic dry-purification evidence.

verses.summary: Remembering divine favor and pledged obedience is widespread covenant exhortation; no distinct prior textual passage established in first pass.
pending_questions: Revisit only if an unusually specific source-level formulation emerges.

verses.summary: Justice despite hostility; possible ethical comparison to impartiality and treatment of enemies.
pending_questions: Compare distinct legal contexts; a common ethical principle does not establish literary borrowing.

verses.summary: Promise of forgiveness and reward for belief and good works is a broad religious theme without a distinct earlier account identified.
Condemnation of rejecting signs and punishment is generic eschatological warning without a source-specific parallel established.
